clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once traveled with General Norman Schwartzkopf, the four-star general who led the invasion of Iraq.

He asked him: what happens when your army retreats? The general stopped him cold - we never retreat, he said, we regroup.

Same move, same soldiers, same battlefield. All that changed was the word. A retreat feels like losing. A regroup feels like a plan.

That's the whole difference between a poor mindset and a rich one - not the setback, the sentence you tell yourself about it.
